### Changed

- (muster) [One definition-editor dialog for servers and workflows](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2776) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The `Edit as JSON` dialog on an MCP server's page and the workflow definition dialog share one implementation. A parse error no longer shows next to an earlier success message, and only a parse error marks the editor invalid.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform, platform-capabilities, repositories) [Hold every busy dialog open through dialogDismissLock](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2782) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Dialogs that write something (new session, create or delete cluster, GPU node pool, model backends, load, pull and import model, capability and repository actions) can no longer be closed mid-write, also not with the header's close button. During a dry run they can now be closed.
- (backend) [Handle the database keepalive rejection at start](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2793) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — For operators: while a database is unreachable at start, the backend no longer logs an `Unhandled rejection` with every retry, and it retries the connection instead of keeping the failed one.
- (backend) [Read GitHub URLs on branches with a slash in the name](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2783) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Templates and catalog files on a branch or tag with a slash in its name, such as `feat/x`, can be registered and run, so they can be tried before they merge.
- (gs) [Pre-fill the edit template's custom version range](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2801) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On a deployment's page, `Edit` keeps a custom automatic-upgrade range such as `>=1.0.0 <3.0.0` instead of replacing it with `^`, `~` or `>=` plus the current version.
- (plans) [Keep Hive History cards within the content area](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2794) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On Hive → History, a card with a long unbroken title, link or command wraps instead of overflowing sideways. Other card grids benefit too.
- (plans) [Keep the portal serving through a rollout; retry gateway 5xx](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2786) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Pages no longer fail with `upstream connect error` while the portal rolls out: the backend keeps serving for 10 s after it is told to stop (chart value `backstage.serverShutdownDelay`). A Hive tab whose source failed offers `Try again`.
- (roadmap) [Read the board per status column, all at once](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2789) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Hive's Roadmap tab loads column by column: the open columns appear within seconds, Done takes up to about a minute, and `All teams` no longer fails. A column that failed to load says so instead of the board showing `No board items`.
- (search) [Keep the search index in Postgres across a restart](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2799) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On installations with a Postgres database, search works right after a portal restart instead of failing until the index is rebuilt, and every replica returns the same results.
- (ui-react) [Jump to #heading links within rendered markdown](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2779) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Table-of-contents and other `#heading` links in rendered markdown (README and SOUL cards, agent system prompts, plans) jump to the heading, and a collapsed card expands to show it.
- (several plugins) [Show loading, not empty, while a failed query's retry waits](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2809) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — After a failed request in a background tab, pages show their loading state until the retry answers, instead of an empty state such as `No merged plans` or a blank MCP server tab.

### Development and CI/CD

- (chart) [Default backstage.args to the image's bundled config](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2796) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — `backstage.args` defaults to the image's bundled config files, so an install that only sets `backstage.appConfig` starts. Managed installations pin `args: []` and are unchanged.
- (chart) [Make the CNPG PodMonitor optional](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2795) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — With `database.engine: postgresql`, the PodMonitor renders only where the cluster has the Prometheus Operator CRDs, and `database.postgresql.podMonitor.enabled: false` turns it off. Installs without the CRDs no longer fail.
- (chart) [Render the VPA only where the cluster serves the API](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2804) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The VerticalPodAutoscaler renders only where the cluster has the VPA CRD, so a default install on a cluster without it (e.g. kind) succeeds.
- (ci) [Align files according to platform standards](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2812) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot]) — Generated update of the shared CI and repository configuration.
- (ci) [Run the Postgres test cases; ATS proves search survives a restart](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2811) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — CI now runs the backend's Postgres search tests, and a chart test restarts the backend and checks that search still answers.
- (deps) [Update dependency fs-extra to v11.4.1](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2788) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (e2e) [Give tsc a 6 GiB heap; tsc and e2e run without core dumps](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2792) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — `yarn tsc` no longer runs out of memory locally, and type checks and e2e runs leave no core dumps in the checkout.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v2.92.1...v2.92.2
